items: 24 V DC to 120/240 V split-phase pure sine inverter charger
why: The shopper asked for one product, and ChatGPT answered by ranking single 24 V split-phase inverter chargers (SunGold 6000W, AIMS 6000W, SunGold 4000W, WZRELB 4000W); the shopper already has a 24 V battery bank, and the separate solar charge controller only matters if they add solar. What decides the pick is fit, not a set: whether it has native 120/240 V output instead of two stacked units, how many watts one 120 V leg can carry, surge for well pumps and motors, roughly 280 A of battery draw at 6 kW on 24 V, and UL/ETL listing. Note that Dealectric's Sun Gold Power listings are all 48 V, so this page needs 24 V models it does not yet list.
